_comment: Item sources kept by hand (DECISIONS D-156): where an item comes from when none of our sources (AllTheThings, the item scan, the collectors, the client tables, wowsrc) knows it. tools/build_gear.py adds each entry as a source record of the item after the automatic sources; one an automatic source already gives is not added twice, and the addon's collector keeps learning sources from kills as before. Only facts the user saw in game or told, each entry with "src" saying who saw it when (e.g. "Nutzer 2026-11-20 (im Spiel gesehen)"). Other sources come in through their own scripts, never by hand: QuestieDB through tools/questie_data.py (D-157, only for items no other source names, and a hand entry wins over it); never copied from Wowhead (D-03), and nothing from another addon or site the user has not decided on (D-04). An item gets into the planner like any other: it needs its scanned or client stats (until then its id goes to the gear scan, GearData M). Kinds and their fields: D boss drop in a dungeon or raid: dungeon (the key in tools/forever_dungeons.json), boss (English name), npc (NPC id); Q quest reward: quest (quest id), optional name, level, min, faction (A/H); V vendor: npc, name, zone (uiMapID), optional faction (A/H); R rare mob: npc, name, zone; W world drop: optional zone, or a named mob outside instances with npc and name. Any other field, a missing one or a bad id stops the build.
